title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - PerformanceIndicatorSpecification
description: Holds the definition of the requested Performance indicator including: its name, value type, collection type, description and units. (TM Forum TMF628 Performance 4.0.0, Swagger definition PerformanceIndicatorSpecification; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:PerformanceIndicatorSpecification:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'PerformanceIndicatorSpecification'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PerformanceIndicatorSpecification/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:PerformanceIndicatorSpecification:<tmfId>. A unique identifier for the PerformanceIndicatorSpecification.

derivationAlgorithm.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PerformanceIndicatorSpecification/properties/derivationAlgorithm'. A step-by-step procedure used to calculate the value of PerformanceIndicator.

derivationMethod.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PerformanceIndicatorSpecification/properties/derivationMethod'. For simple calculations, the method used to calculate the value of a PerformanceIndicator, such as average, minimum, maximum, sum and so forth.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PerformanceIndicatorSpecification/properties/description'. A narrative that explains in detail what the PerformanceIndicatorSpecification is.

indicatorCategory.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PerformanceIndicatorSpecification/properties/indicatorCategory'. A grouping or set of PerformanceIndicatorSpecifications that are classified together because of common characteristics, such as technology specific, service specific, or technology/service independent.

indicatorUnit.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PerformanceIndicatorSpecification/properties/indicatorUnit'. The unit by which the indicator is measured. For example, seconds, KBs, rate per second, etc.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PerformanceIndicatorSpecification/properties/name'. A word, term, or phrase by which a PerformanceIndicatorSpecification is known and distinguished from other PerformanceIndicatorSpecifications.

perspective.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PerformanceIndicatorSpecification/properties/perspective'. The point of view for the PerformanceIndicatorSpecification, such as a single user instance or aggregation.

collectionType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PerformanceIndicatorSpecification/properties/collectionType'. The type of collection: gauge, cumulative,delta,discrete event,status inspection. Indicators can be produced using these methods.

indicatorType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PerformanceIndicatorSpecification/properties/indicatorType'. A kind of value that the PerformanceIndicator can take; double float,int, string.

performanceIndicatorSpecRelationship.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF628_Performance/blob/f958e5c2831aa61286e9356282cf451b16e7a5d2/TMF628-Performance-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/PerformanceIndicatorSpecification/properties/performanceIndicatorSpecRelationship'.
